style: Natural street portrait, soft natural lighting, subtle East Asian aesthetic, balanced color, restrained retouching.

subject.appearance: Tall, slender, long straight black-brown hair, fair luminous skin, minimal natural makeup.
subject.pose: Full-body, standing upright, waist slightly turned, gentle smile, direct gaze with left eye.
subject.wardrobe: White long-sleeve shirt, light-gray cardigan sweater, white loose pants, white sneakers.

environment.setting: Urban street, clean neutral backdrop, cold and quiet mood.

photography.lighting: Natural daylight key light, soft fill flash (low intensity), warm highlights, soft shadows.

camera.exposure: Aperture f/2.0, ISO 100, shallow depth of field.

photography.framing: Vertical orientation, full-body crop, eye-level angle, centered composition.

post_production.color_grade: Bright, clean, slightly cool tone, moderate-high contrast, subtle saturation.
post_production.retouching: Natural skin texture, selective sharpening on eyes and facial features.
